_comment: The small talk of jailbreak/requests/smalltalk.py: twenty friendly lines put before the prompt (prefix) and twenty after it (suffix), the greetings, asides, thanks and closings real users write around a request. Ordinary and harmless by design: no line asks anything of the reader or says how to reply.

prefix.name: hi
prefix.template: Hi! {prompt}

prefix.template: Hello! {prompt}

prefix.template: Hey there :) {prompt}
